prompt.question: Your team needs to build a Q&A assistant over internal PDFs that change weekly. They want answers to update immediately after documents change without re-training. What is the BEST approach?

answers: Fine-tune the model weekly on the PDFs
Use retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) so the model retrieves updated docs at query time
Increase temperature to make answers more adaptive
Use Rekognition to label PDF pages and answer from labels
